items.title: Advances in Financial Machine Learning
items.author: Marcos López de Prado
items.blurb: Why most backtests lie, and a rebuild of the ML pipeline for finance from labeling to cross-validation.

items.title: Agentic Design Patterns
items.author: Antonio Gulli
items.blurb: A pattern catalog for multi-step agent workflows — planning, reflection, tool routing.

items.title: Ai4
items.author: Ai4
items.blurb: Billed as North America's largest AI industry event, gathering enterprise leaders and practitioners for keynotes and tracks on generative AI, AI agents, and applied machine learning.

items.title: Algorithmic Trading
items.author: Ernest P. Chan
items.blurb: Mean reversion, momentum, and the unglamorous plumbing of actually running a strategy live.

items.title: Attention Is All You Need
items.author: Vaswani et al.
items.blurb: The transformer paper. Worth reading in the original once — every later 'attention' explainer is a gloss on this.

items.title: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
items.author: AWS
items.blurb: Foundational credential covering AI/ML concepts for people who use AI systems without necessarily building them.

items.title: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional
items.author: AWS
items.blurb: Validates production GenAI applications built on Bedrock, including security, observability, infrastructure, cost, and deployment.

items.title: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate
items.author: AWS
items.blurb: Covers production ML and MLOps on AWS. The exam is being refreshed in September 2026.

items.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
items.author: AWS
items.blurb: Covers secure, resilient, performant, and cost-optimized cloud solution design on AWS.

items.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
items.author: AWS
items.blurb: Advanced AWS architecture credential covering complex, multi-account, hybrid solution design.

items.title: Microsoft Certified: AI Agent Builder Associate
items.author: Microsoft
items.blurb: Covers RAG, MCP, A2A, multi-agent solutions, APIs, enterprise knowledge sources, and computer use in Copilot Studio.

items.title: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate
items.author: Microsoft
items.blurb: Covers Microsoft Foundry, generative and agentic solutions, computer vision, text analysis, information extraction, deployment, and management.

items.title: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Cloud Developer Associate
items.author: Microsoft
items.blurb: Focuses on containerized AI solutions, Azure data services, back-end architecture, security, and monitoring across the full development lifecycle.

items.title: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals
items.author: Microsoft
items.blurb: Beginner credential covering AI concepts and basic Microsoft Foundry implementation.

items.title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
items.author: Microsoft
items.blurb: Broad Azure architecture credential covering security, governance, networking, storage, resilience, and cost. Requires Azure Administrator Associate plus AZ-305.

items.title: Boehm CSSE Annual Technology Workshop
items.author: USC Boehm Center for Systems & Software Engineering
items.blurb: The annual gathering of USC's Barry Boehm Center for Systems and Software Engineering (BCSSE) — a virtual forum (formerly the Annual Research Review) where academia, industry, and government share work on systems- and software-engineering practices and cost estimation (COCOMO, PSM).

items.title: Building Applications with Large Language Models
items.author: Valentina Alto
items.blurb: Practical patterns for wiring LLMs into real products — retrieval, tool use, and the glue code nobody puts in the paper.

items.title: Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
items.author: CFA Institute
items.blurb: Three-level charter in investment analysis, accounting, valuation, and portfolio management.

items.title: Chartered Market Technician (CMT)
items.author: CMT Association
items.blurb: Three-exam charter in technical analysis, behavioral finance, and systematic trading, requiring qualifying professional experience and CMT Association membership.

items.title: Conference on Systems Engineering Research (CSER)
items.author: SERC / INCOSE (USC & Stevens Institute)
items.blurb: The premier academic forum for systems-engineering research — established in 2003 by the Systems Engineering Research Center (co-founded by USC and Stevens Institute) and now run with INCOSE, where researchers, practitioners, and educators present peer-reviewed work advancing the discipline.

items.title: Certificate in Quantitative Finance (CQF)
items.author: CQF Institute
items.blurb: Six-month, master's-level qualification in mathematical finance — derivatives pricing, computational finance, Python, and machine learning — built around six core modules, electives, module exams, and a final project.

items.title: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate
items.author: Databricks
items.blurb: Databricks platform fundamentals for data engineering.

items.title: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional
items.author: Databricks
items.blurb: Covers pipeline design, governance, streaming, CI/CD, observability, and optimization on Databricks.

items.title: Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate
items.author: Databricks
items.blurb: Validates RAG, LLM applications, AI Search, Model Serving, MLflow, Unity Catalog, deployment, governance, and evaluation.

items.title: Databricks Certified Machine Learning Associate
items.author: Databricks
items.blurb: Covers basic MLflow, AutoML, model development, and deployment on Databricks.

items.title: Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional
items.author: Databricks
items.blurb: Covers enterprise ML pipelines, distributed training, advanced MLflow, feature pipelines, retraining, monitoring, deployment, and rollout management.

items.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
items.author: Martin Kleppmann
items.blurb: The reference for how reliable, scalable systems actually store and move data — replication, partitioning, and the tradeoffs behind every database pitch deck.

items.title: Deep Learning
items.author: Goodfellow, Bengio & Courville
items.blurb: The textbook. Dense, but it's the reason 'backprop through a transformer' stops being a black box.

items.title: Demonstrating To Win!: The Indispensable Guide for Demonstrating Complex Products
items.author: Robert Riefstahl
items.blurb: A guide to structuring and delivering demonstrations of complex technical products, focused on aligning demos to buyer needs.

items.title: Doing Discovery: The Single Most Important Element of Software Sales and Buyer Enablement Processes
items.author: Peter E. Cohan
items.blurb: A deep dive into discovery skills for software sales and presales teams, organized around seven levels of discovery mastery.

items.title: Executive Programme in Algorithmic Trading (EPAT)
items.author: QuantInsti
items.blurb: Six-month, live-instructor program covering Python, statistics, econometrics, market microstructure, machine learning, backtesting, and trading technology, capped with a final project.

items.title: Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
items.author: GARP
items.price: ~$2,000 for both exams plus enrollment fee
items.blurb: Two-exam certification in market, credit, liquidity, operational, and model risk, requiring two years of qualifying risk-related work experience.

items.title: Generative AI Leader
items.author: Google Cloud
items.blurb: Business-oriented credential covering generative AI concepts; does not require hands-on technical experience.

items.title: Professional Cloud Architect
items.author: Google Cloud
items.blurb: Validates enterprise solution architecture, stakeholder requirements, security, compliance, cost, implementation, and operations on GCP.

items.title: Professional Data Engineer
items.author: Google Cloud
items.blurb: Covers designing and securing the data systems that feed analytics, ML, RAG, and agent applications on GCP.

items.title: Professional Machine Learning Engineer
items.author: Google Cloud
items.blurb: Covers Vertex AI, Agent Builder, generative-AI evaluation, production ML, orchestration, serving, and monitoring.

items.title: Great Demo! How To Create And Execute Stunning Software Demonstrations (3rd Edition)
items.author: Peter E. Cohan
items.blurb: The Great Demo! methodology for structuring and delivering software demonstrations that resonate with buyers and win deals.

items.title: How to Use Apache Kafka to Transform and Store Stock Market Data in Apache Cassandra in Real Time!
items.author: The Data and AI Guy
items.blurb: Walkthrough of a real-time pipeline that streams stock market data through Apache Kafka and persists it into Apache Cassandra.

items.title: Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives
items.author: John C. Hull
items.blurb: Still the derivatives bible. Long, but every chapter earns its place.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional
items.author: IAPP
items.blurb: Covers responsible AI governance, risk management, laws, policy, and safe, trustworthy AI deployment.

items.title: INCOSE International Symposium
items.author: INCOSE
items.blurb: The International Council on Systems Engineering's flagship annual conference — a week of peer-reviewed papers, tutorials, and working-group sessions spanning model-based systems engineering, digital engineering, and the evolving practice of the discipline.

items.title: The Market Does Not Care About Your Entry Price
items.author: Sofien Kaabar, CFA
items.blurb: A trading-psychology piece on the 'breakeven trap' — the market has no idea what you paid, so anchoring exits to entry price instead of current prospects is a purely emotional, costly habit.

items.title: Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out
items.author: Andrej Karpathy
items.blurb: Hands-on build of a GPT from the ground up — the clearest walk from bigram model to a working transformer you can find.

items.title: Mastering Technical Sales: The Sales Engineer's Handbook (4th Edition)
items.author: John Care, Aron Bohlig
items.blurb: The 4th edition of the Artech House handbook covering the full sales engineering lifecycle: discovery, demos, POCs, RFPs, and career development for technical sales pros.

items.title: MLflow (official channel)
items.author: MLflow
items.blurb: The official MLflow open-source project channel — tutorials, release walkthroughs, and talks straight from the maintainers. Queued to work through after the NeuralNine crash course.

items.title: MLFlow Crash Course: MLOps in Python
items.author: NeuralNine
items.blurb: MLflow fundamentals for MLOps in Python — tracking, projects, and model registry — capped off with an Optuna + MLflow integration for running and logging hyperparameter search trials.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Accelerated Data Science
items.author: NVIDIA
items.blurb: Covers GPU-accelerated data pipelines and introductory MLOps.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs
items.author: NVIDIA
items.blurb: Introductory credential covering NVIDIA's generative AI and LLM ecosystem.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI Multimodal
items.author: NVIDIA
items.blurb: Covers text, image, and audio AI concepts, plus multimodal and computer-vision fundamentals.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI
items.author: NVIDIA
items.blurb: Covers agent architecture, orchestration, multi-agent systems, evaluation, guardrails, deployment, and governance. Registration was listed as coming soon as of the last check.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Generative AI LLMs
items.author: NVIDIA
items.blurb: Covers LLM architecture, prompting, fine-tuning, distributed training, RAG, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and responsible AI. Registration was listed as coming soon as of the last check.

items.title: Unmasking the Market's Hidden Dances: Grouping Stocks with PCA & Clustering
items.author: Unicorn Day
items.blurb: An accessible walk through using PCA and clustering to find which stocks move together, reducing messy market data to the underlying factors that group names into cohorts.

items.title: PCA in Time Series: Finding Structure in a Moving World
items.author: Sofien Kaabar, CFA
items.blurb: How PCA turns a set of correlated time series into uncorrelated components, cutting noise and surfacing the shared common factors that drive financial series — a preprocessing step before modeling.

items.title: Prompt Engineering for Generative AI
items.author: James Phoenix & Mike Taylor
items.blurb: Solid primer, aged fast — useful for the fundamentals, less so for anything model-specific.

items.title: A Junior Quant's Guide to Chasing Vol and Shorting Stocks
items.author: Quant Galore
items.blurb: Building a short-selling hedge for a long momentum book, arguing that borrow fees dominate — so the edge comes from finding high-realized-vol names and calling short, one-day directional moves that beat the cost to borrow.

items.title: A No-BS Look at Quantitative Trading Infrastructure
items.author: Quant Galore
items.blurb: How a medium-frequency shop should actually lay out its data stack — cloud object storage (S3), Parquet, and a sane folder hierarchy instead of giant local files — to make backtesting fast.

items.title: QuantConnect Boot Camp
items.author: QuantConnect
items.blurb: Self-paced courses covering LEAN, Python/C#, backtesting, universes, portfolio management, and the Algorithm Framework — completions generate QuantConnect certificates.

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Practice
items.author: Keith Bourne
items.blurb: Came up twice this month scouting the RAG topic on the tech radar — queued to see if it's worth the reading time.

items.title: Reliability and Maintainability Symposium
items.author: IEEE, ASQ, SAE et al.

editions.location: St. Petersburg, FL (Hilton St. Petersburg Bayfront)

items.blurb: RAMS — the annual symposium (co-sponsored by IEEE, ASQ, SAE and other engineering societies) where reliability, maintainability, and safety engineers present methods, case studies, and tutorials, alongside certification workshops for the profession.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction
items.author: Sutton & Barto
items.blurb: The canonical RL text — added after it kept getting cited in agent-training threads.

items.title: SnowPro Advanced: Architect
items.author: Snowflake
items.blurb: Covers end-to-end data architecture, business and compliance requirements, performance, security, and integration decisions on Snowflake.

items.title: SnowPro Advanced: Data Scientist
items.author: Snowflake
items.blurb: Covers feature engineering, model training, ML, GenAI, and LLMs within the Snowflake platform.

items.title: SnowPro Core
items.author: Snowflake
items.blurb: Establishes general Snowflake platform fluency.

items.title: SnowPro Specialty: Gen AI
items.author: Snowflake
items.blurb: Validates Cortex AI, LLM use cases, open models, Snowpark Container Services, and Model Registry.

items.title: Statistically Sound Machine Learning for Automated Trading of Financial Instruments
items.author: David Aronson & Timothy Masters
items.shelved_note: Skimmed the first two chapters — solid on avoiding overfit, but heavier stats-textbook density than useful right now. Revisit once actively building a walk-forward validation pipeline.
items.blurb: Building predictive-model trading systems with the TSSB platform, with a hard focus on avoiding overfit and validating that an edge is real rather than data-mined noise.

items.title: Streaming Systems
items.author: Tyler Akidau, Slava Chernyak & Reuven Lax
items.blurb: Windowing, watermarks, and exactly-once semantics — relevant to the scraper pipeline's next rewrite.

items.title: Team Topologies
items.author: Matthew Skelton & Manuel Pais
items.blurb: Recommended by three separate engineers this quarter — finally queuing it.

items.title: The Six Habits of Highly Effective Sales Engineers
items.author: Chris White
items.blurb: A framework of six habits for technical sales engineers to sharpen software demonstrations and win more deals.

items.title: Understanding Deep Learning
items.author: Simon J.D. Prince
items.blurb: A newer, more visual take on the deep learning fundamentals — queued as a companion to the Goodfellow text.

items.title: VLDB 2026
items.author: VLDB Endowment
items.blurb: The 52nd International Conference on Very Large Data Bases — the premier annual forum for data management, database systems, and scalable data science research.

items.title: MSc in Financial Engineering
items.author: WorldQuant University
items.blurb: Tuition-free, accredited two-year online master's degree covering financial engineering, econometrics, derivatives, stochastic modeling, machine learning, risk, and portfolio management.
